test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 11 Jan 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: A bus covers a distance of 5 km in 20 min. If its speed is decreased by 3 km/hr, then find the time taken by the bus to cover the same distance.
solution:
**Given:**

Distance covered in 20 minutes by the bus = 5 km 

Reduction in speed by = 3 km/h 

**Formula used:**

Speed = Distance/Time 

**Calculation:**

Initial speed of the bus = 5 km/ 20 minutes 

⇒ 5 km/ 20 × 60 

⇒ 15 km/h 

After reduction in speed, 

Time = 5 km/(15 km/h - 3 km/h) 

⇒ 5/12 hours 

⇒ 5/12 × 60 minutes 

⇒ 25 minutes

**∴ The required time is 25 minutes. **
